translations.web: Behold, Yahweh’s storm, his wrath, has gone out, a sweeping storm: it will burst on the head of the wicked.
translations.bsb: Behold, the storm of the LORD has gone out with fury, a whirlwind swirling down upon the heads of the wicked.
translations.kjv: Behold, the whirlwind of the LORD goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.
translations.asv: Behold, the tempest of Jehovah, even his wrath, is gone forth, a sweeping tempest: it shall burst upon the head of the wicked.
